rootCauses.rootCause: Main repairHintFor now returns a Not evaluated target/reason when the next level is unmeasurable (P1-07). The historical harness compiles the old advice unchanged and compares full JSON; repairHint-derived rowHash/manifestHash/packHash then legitimately diverge.
rootCauses.remedy: Reuse the two literal recorded forward edits and full strengthened harness; keep full JSON parity, exact original hashes, once-only text guards, delta restriction to repairHint/rowHash/manifestHash and tests retaining archived advice at evaluable levels.

rootCauses.rootCause: P1-26 makes proof algorithm and size come from carried signed-root state. Archived verifiers pass merkleRoot:null into the actual live proof checker; without a root the checker uses amc-legacy-v1 and refuses new rfc9162-sha256 proof fixtures. Main current verifiers pass signed roots through P0-09 admission, producing true-vs-false and error-array parity differences.
